title: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
abstract: arXiv:2609.21667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibility reports of the SIGMOD Availability and Reproducibility Initiative (ARI). This yields a curated corpus of 4,397 $\langle$DOI, repository-URL$\rangle$ pairs. We design two distinct application profiles grounded in Wikidata classes (one for scholarly articles, one for software instances) aligned with the schema.org and CodeMeta vocabularies. This architectural separation enables rule-based reconciliation

translated_title: 从代码存档到知识图谱：连接 Software Heritage、COAR Notify 与 Wikidata
translated_abstract: 软件是一等的科学对象，然而源代码与学术记录之间经过验证的关联在关联开放数据（LOD）云中仍然普遍缺失，这使得被存档的软件制品游离于语义发现之外。本文提出了一个端到端的数据调和流水线，从论文与其源代码之间链接明确且经过编辑核验的来源中采集、验证并建模“出版物—代码仓库”配对：这些来源包括以软件为核心的期刊 JOSS、SoftwareX 和 IPOL，以及 SIGMOD 可用性与可复现性倡议（ARI）的可复现性报告。由此构建了一个包含 4,397 对 ⟨DOI, 仓库URL⟩ 的精选语料库。我们基于 Wikidata 类别设计了两种不同的应用概要（一种面向学术文章，一种面向软件实例），并与 schema.org 和 CodeMeta 词汇体系保持一致。这种架构上的分离使得基于规则的调和成为可能。
tldr: 该论文提出一条端到端流水线，从 JOSS、SoftwareX、IPOL 等软件期刊和 SIGMOD ARI 可复现性报告中采集并验证了 4,397 对论文与代码仓库的关联，并通过基于 Wikidata 的双应用概要建模，将软件存档与学术成果桥接进关联开放数据知识图谱。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that curates 4,397 verified DOI-to-repository links from software-centric journals and SIGMOD ARI reports, and models them with two Wikidata-grounded application profiles to bridge software archives and the scholarly record in the Linked Open Data cloud.
